name: Naboth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Naboth had a vineyard next to Ahab's palace in Jezreel, and Ahab asked to trade or buy it, offering a better vineyard or its worth in money.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: Naboth refused because the land was the inheritance of his fathers. He could not simply hand off an inheritance that was given to him.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: Jezebel mocked his weakness, telling him he was king and should let his heart be merry, and she promised to get the vineyard of Naboth for him.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: Jezebel wrote letters in Ahab's name and sealed them with his seal, sending them to the elders and nobles of Naboth's city.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: The elders and nobles obeyed Jezebel's letters, proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: Two children of Belial, children of the devil, sat before Naboth and falsely witnessed that he had blasphemed God and the king.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: They carried Naboth out and stoned him to death, then sent word to Jezebel that he was dead.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: When Jezebel heard Naboth was dead, she told Ahab to arise and take possession of the vineyard he had been refused.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: Elijah was to declare, Thus saith the Lord, hast thou killed and also taken possession, and in the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs would lick Ahab's own blood.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab
